name: Shiori no Haisetsu Nikki
source:
"From now on you have to poop and I'm going to watch you poop."

Quiet little Shiori has been coerced by her creepy classmate to do the most shameful things.

But she finds perverse satisfaction in it. Days of fecal taboo pleasures begin.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE103621.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“从现在开始你必须拉屎，我会看着你拉屎。”

安静的小诗织被她令人毛骨悚然的同学胁迫去做最可耻的事情。

但她却从中找到了反常的满足感。粪便禁忌快乐的日子开始了。
